subject_line: 90 Days In and Nothing Changed? Read This.
opening: Hey, we've got a big one this week and you're going to want to read it before you decide whether carnivore is actually working for you. We're also talking long Covid, perimenopause, and the age-old question of what to cook when your partner thinks steak for dinner is 'extreme.' Grab your coffee. Let's get into it.

hero.title: 3 Months of Carnivore After 50: What Should Have Changed
hero.teaser: Three months in, and you're staring at the scale wondering if any of this is actually doing something. It's a question Sarah hears constantly from readers over 50, and the answer is more nuanced than you'd expect. Some things that feel like nothing are actually signs the process is working. And some things you're waiting for? They take longer than the internet tells you.

supporting.title: Carnivore for Long Covid: What Readers Over 50 Report
supporting.teaser: Readers who couldn't walk to the mailbox without crashing share what happened after they switched to meat and salt, and the pattern Sarah noticed surprised even her.

supporting.title: Carnivore in Perimenopause: Why Your Cycle Goes Haywire
supporting.teaser: If your cycle stopped making sense right after you went carnivore, Sarah explains the one question you need to ask before blaming the diet.

supporting.title: Starting Carnivore When Your Husband Won't Join You
supporting.teaser: Chloe asked the community how they cook one dinner for two very different eaters, and the answer is simpler than you think.

try_this_week: Print the 30-day meal plan and do one grocery run from it. Marcus put portions in ounces, the lists are short, and the whole point is to stop making decisions at 5 pm when your willpower is shot. Grab it, pick a start date, and put it on the fridge tonight.
looking_ahead: Next week we're getting into something Marcus has been tracking with performance clients over 55, and the number that keeps showing up in their labs is not the one anyone expects.
